title: Spectral Landmarks: Alignment of Landmark Kernel Translates with the Leading Eigenfunctions of a Kernel Operator
abstract: arXiv:2611.20336v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the problem of choosing $m$ landmark points so that the span of the kernel translates is as close as possible to the leading $s$-dimensional eigenspace of a positive-definite kernel. The natural measure is the Hilbert-Schmidt operator discrepancy between the reproducing-kernel-Hilbert-space (RKHS) projectors onto the two subspaces. We give a closed form spectral alignment function in terms of the truncated Mercer kernel and relate it to the classical integrated power function (Nystr\"om trace error) through a two-sided sandwich bound. Minimizing the function by gradient descent on the landmark coordinates produces landmark sets that are evenly spaced. Theoretical results show that optimal configurations are those whose eigenfunction sampling matrix is a scaled isometry. translated_title: 谱地标点：地标核平移与核算子主特征函数的对齐
translated_abstract: 我们研究选择 $m$ 个地标点的问题，使得核平移的张成空间尽可能接近正定核的主 $s$ 维特征子空间。自然的度量是投影到这两个子空间上的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）投影子之间的 Hilbert-Schmidt 算子偏差。我们给出了以截断 Mercer 核表示的谱对齐函数的闭式表达式，并通过一个双侧夹逼界将其与经典的积分幂函数（Nyström 迹误差）联系起来。通过在地标坐标上进行梯度下降来最小化该函数，所产生的地标集是均匀间隔分布的。理论结果表明，最优配置是那些特征函数采样矩阵为缩放等距映射的配置。在齐性空间上，这些配置恰好是主特征函数乘积的最小等权求积规则，并且对于每个 $m \ge s$，它们是……
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于 Hilbert-Schmidt 算子偏差的谱对齐准则来选择地标点，使核平移空间逼近正定核的主特征子空间，并证明最优地标配置是特征函数采样矩阵为缩放等距映射的均匀分布点集，且在齐性空间上等价于最小等权求积规则。
